mapper.sql: R.INSTITUTION_ID, R.REQ_SEQ, R.REQ_KEY, R.STATUS_CD, R.OPEN_INST_ID, R.PREV_DOMAINS, R.REQUESTED_BY, R.REQUESTED_AT, R.REQ_VERIFIED, R.RUN_MODE, R.RUN_BY, R.RUN_AT, R.RUN_VERIFIED, R.RUN_DOMAINS, R.RUN_RESULT_CD, R.JOB_ID, R.APPLIED_IMPORT_ID, R.CLOSED_AT, R.CLOSED_BY, R.CLOSE_REASON

SELECT , I.NAME_KO AS NAME_KO, L.LAST_IMPORT_AT AS LAST_IMPORT_AT, U.NAME AS RUN_BY_NAME FROM PLAN_COLLECT_REQ R LEFT JOIN INSTITUTIONS I ON I.INSTITUTION_ID = R.INSTITUTION_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT INSTITUTION_ID, MAX(IMPORTED_AT) AS LAST_IMPORT_AT FROM INST_PLAN_IMPORT WHERE ORIGIN_CD = 'IMPORT' GROUP BY INSTITUTION_ID) L ON L.INSTITUTION_ID = R.INSTITUTION_ID LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.EMP_NO = R.RUN_BY
mapper.select: SELECT INSTITUTION_ID FROM INSTITUTIONS WHERE UPPER(INSTITUTION_ID) = UPPER(#{institutionId})
SELECT INSTITUTION_ID FROM INSTITUTIONS WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT NAME_KO FROM INSTITUTIONS WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId}
SELECT D.SRC_URL FROM INST_PLAN_DOC D WHERE D.IMPORT_ID = (SELECT MAX(P.IMPORT_ID) FROM INST_PLAN_IMPORT P WHERE P.INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId}) AND D.SRC_URL IS NOT NULL ORDER BY D.DOC_SEQ
SELECT FROM PLAN_COLLECT_REQ R WHERE R.OPEN_INST_ID = #{institutionId}
SELECT FROM PLAN_COLLECT_REQ R WHERE R.REQ_KEY = #{reqKey}
SELECT FROM PLAN_COLLECT_REQ R WHERE R.INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} AND R.REQ_SEQ = #{reqSeq}
SELECT MAX(LOGGED_AT) FROM INST_PLAN_ACT WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} AND ACTION_CD = 'COLLECT_RUN' AND OUTCOME = 'STARTED'
WHERE R.REQ_KEY IN #{k} ORDER BY R.REQUESTED_AT
WHERE R.OPEN_INST_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY R.REQUESTED_AT
WHERE R.OPEN_INST_ID IS NULL ORDER BY R.CLOSED_AT DESC
SELECT STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM PLAN_COLLECT_REQ WHERE OPEN_INST_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY STATUS_CD
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(REQ_SEQ), 0) + 1 FROM PLAN_COLLECT_REQ WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLAN_COLLECT_REQ (INSTITUTION_ID, REQ_SEQ, REQ_KEY, STATUS_CD, OPEN_INST_ID, PREV_DOMAINS, REQUESTED_BY, REQUESTED_AT, REQ_VERIFIED, RUN_VERIFIED) VALUES (#{institutionId}, #{reqSeq}, #{reqKey}, #{statusCd}, #{openInstId}, #{prevDomains,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestedBy}, #{requestedAt}, #{reqVerified}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT EMP_NO AS EMP_NO, CANCELED_AT AS CANCELED_AT FROM PLAN_COLLECT_REQUESTER WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} AND REQ_SEQ = #{reqSeq} AND EMP_NO = #{empNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLAN_COLLECT_REQUESTER (INSTITUTION_ID, REQ_SEQ, EMP_NO, REQUESTED_AT, EMP_VERIFIED) VALUES (#{institutionId}, #{reqSeq}, #{empNo}, #{at}, #{verified})
mapper.update: UPDATE PLAN_COLLECT_REQUESTER SET CANCELED_AT = NULL, REQUESTED_AT = #{at}, EMP_VERIFIED = #{verified} WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} AND REQ_SEQ = #{reqSeq} AND EMP_NO = #{empNo} AND CANCELED_AT IS NOT NULL
UPDATE PLAN_COLLECT_REQUESTER SET CANCELED_AT = #{at} WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} AND REQ_SEQ = #{reqSeq} AND EMP_NO = #{empNo} AND CANCELED_AT IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLAN_COLLECT_REQUESTER WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} AND REQ_SEQ = #{reqSeq} AND CANCELED_AT IS NULL
SELECT EMP_NO FROM PLAN_COLLECT_REQUESTER WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} AND REQ_SEQ = #{reqSeq} AND CANCELED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY REQUESTED_AT

SELECT R.REQ_KEY AS REQ_KEY, Q.EMP_NO AS EMP_NO, U.NAME AS NAME, Q.REQUESTED_AT AS REQUESTED_AT FROM PLAN_COLLECT_REQUESTER Q JOIN PLAN_COLLECT_REQ R ON R.INSTITUTION_ID = Q.INSTITUTION_ID AND R.REQ_SEQ = Q.REQ_SEQ LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.EMP_NO = Q.EMP_NO WHERE Q.CANCELED_AT IS NULL AND R.REQ_KEY IN #{k} ORDER BY Q.REQUESTED_AT

SELECT R.INSTITUTION_ID AS INSTITUTION_ID, Q.EMP_NO AS EMP_NO FROM PLAN_COLLECT_REQUESTER Q JOIN PLAN_COLLECT_REQ R ON R.INSTITUTION_ID = Q.INSTITUTION_ID AND R.REQ_SEQ = Q.REQ_SEQ WHERE Q.CANCELED_AT IS NULL AND R.OPEN_INST_ID IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE PLAN_COLLECT_REQ SET STATUS_CD = 'RUNNING', RUN_MODE = #{mode}, RUN_BY = #{empNo}, RUN_AT = #{at}, RUN_VERIFIED = #{verified}, RUN_DOMAINS = #{domains,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, RUN_RESULT_CD = NULL, JOB_ID = NULL WHERE REQ_KEY = #{reqKey} AND STATUS_CD = 'REQUESTED'
UPDATE PLAN_COLLECT_REQ SET JOB_ID = #{jobId}, RUN_RESULT_CD = 'SENT' WHERE REQ_KEY = #{reqKey} AND STATUS_CD = 'RUNNING' AND RUN_MODE = 'AGENT' AND JOB_ID IS NULL

UPDATE PLAN_COLLECT_REQ SET STATUS_CD = 'REQUESTED', RUN_RESULT_CD = #{code}, RUN_MODE = NULL, RUN_BY = NULL, RUN_AT = NULL, RUN_VERIFIED = 0, RUN_DOMAINS = NULL WHERE REQ_KEY = #{reqKey} AND STATUS_CD = 'RUNNING' AND RUN_MODE = 'AGENT' AND JOB_ID IS NULL

UPDATE PLAN_COLLECT_REQ SET STATUS_CD = 'APPLIED', OPEN_INST_ID = NULL, CLOSED_AT = #{at}, CLOSED_BY = #{empNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, APPLIED_IMPORT_ID = #{importId} WHERE OPEN_INST_ID = #{institutionId} AND STATUS_CD IN ('REQUESTED', 'RUNNING')
